exposure: Previous cesarean section due to dystocia
Previous cesarean section for non-cephalic presentation
Time since last cesarean section (<18 months vs ≥18 months)
cohort: The study included 38,686 women with one cesarean section and at least one following delivery from the Swedish Medical Birth Register, 1998-2013.
finding: A prediction model for vaginal birth after one cesarean delivery was developed and found to be satisfactory in predicting VBAC success.
